
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/ifmeme/p/19296889/apipost" title="发布于 2025-12-02 11:52">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Apipost 自动化测试实战：用 IF 控制器实现“增删改查”依赖链</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-diagnose-id="17f64202b13464e77e2fd610003bf738">在日常的API测试中，我们经常遇到后一个请求依赖于前一个请求结果的情况。比如，删除一条数据前，必须先成功创建它；或者，当查询结果为空时，我们可能希望跳过后续的更新操作。在这种场景下，简单的线性测试脚本就无法满足需求了。<br data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="25b2cc723725456715b57f6e308d01bc">Apipost的自动化测试功能提供了很便捷的条件判断功能，允许我们根据前一个请求的响应结果，动态地决定后续测试的执行流程。今天将通过一个完整的“公寓管理”（增删改查）案例，手把手带你掌握如何在Apipost中使用条件判断，构建一个自动化测试集。</p>
<p class="template_1 color_000000" data-bjh-box="template_header" data-bjh-params="{&quot;templateId&quot;:&quot;1&quot;,&quot;color&quot;:&quot;000000&quot;,&quot;index&quot;:&quot;01&quot;,&quot;content&quot;:&quot;一、 测试场景与接口说明&quot;}" data-diagnose-id="5c41f7a0cdfbf3154968de030dc5de23"><strong><span class="count" data-diagnose-id="a37f3156fc3b970b12e6d762cfc04a65"><span class="content" data-diagnose-id="944a4b758def0d6b4683666896068dc0">一、 测试场景与接口说明</span></span></strong></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="6b70ae3be423ab8f2c59dfacd26e28d8">假设我们正在测试一个简单的公寓管理模块，包含四个核心接口：</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="5936682d01f20b33312e95fb946c5661">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="4df728d8e8de4603a98c68b26a0a9506"><span data-diagnose-id="9d5cf6638fc4be01b1e9548c31d9e5ee">自动化测试目标：创建一个测试集，按“增-&gt;查-&gt;改-&gt;删”的顺序执行。关键在于，每一步都依赖于上一步的成功执行。例如，只有成功创建公寓后，才能用返回的Id去查询、更新和删除</span></p>
<p class="template_1 color_000000" data-bjh-box="template_header" data-bjh-params="{&quot;templateId&quot;:&quot;1&quot;,&quot;color&quot;:&quot;000000&quot;,&quot;index&quot;:&quot;02&quot;,&quot;content&quot;:&quot;二、 在ApiPost中配置条件判断&quot;}" data-diagnose-id="add203384bcd13a1de32ec161e4d05cb"><strong><span class="count" data-diagnose-id="8cea2b5e857f3824125413c0bc6ae62a"><span class="content" data-diagnose-id="156b7fee70611123f453b6cc2bcf33b0">二、 在ApiPost中配置条件判断</span></span></strong></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="6fce9aa12f9c3c849e67031a077d60e9">步骤1：创建自动化测试集并添加接口</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="9b287d05da7bb0770e262fc73df57485">在Apipost-自动化测试中创建一个名为“公寓管理自动化测试”的测试集。</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="9e0c1ef1e7edfb9a84c15488730616c5">将上述四个接口及登录接口导入到测试集中。</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="fa6415729ca3d9fd2c45bf7c607e64e9"><span data-diagnose-id="23ccd88a215f67f722a3945abd8976a4"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="043d27240a70101ada36db5b001356e8" data-bjh-helper-id="5ce636a7-0a7c-4953-b8c6-142bf50d6873" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="019a12a0d09a6942890afb6c1a2fbd5a" data-w="1440" data-h="773" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FNq2q3jbA%2BERTG1QOyJVqalYadzYAHlgRnVxztkVIWht%2FI1wDneHQF7YrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FNq2q3jbA%2BERTG1QOyJVqalYadzYAHlgRnVxztkVIWht%2FI1wDneHQF7YrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="72dcd8becef64c1391692676e2c49ac9"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="755ef2586a44ca84761421853eb650ee"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="b1876cba9cea5d48f401f8e5b7d5e2e1"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="c3a87d1cf8e2d9132c2ce3de35ef0f56">编辑<span class="bjh-image-func-search" data-diagnose-id="8f9e3f82a346e31f817adbec7f3ba07d">搜图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="76f4267d16bf8b1479115d5891cba69f">步骤2：提取新增公寓接口的响应数据id，并为后续接口设置环境变量</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="56b07f242de63edb9ed8da212a456c5d"><span data-diagnose-id="29b90a81b9772a2265c148e4b5886a9e"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="03d86f5c9a109cefdefaa9b05e2eca12" data-bjh-helper-id="9d903b14-7972-4db8-8afd-1d83f7b6ce2b" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="cf632e344dd384d98d861240e22be7a5" data-w="1440" data-h="859" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Ft7wYHuujokrRv95RZy77CO1cftRvaN9YHx8%2FC6hVlUXlqoh0PEl9q7YrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Ft7wYHuujokrRv95RZy77CO1cftRvaN9YHx8%2FC6hVlUXlqoh0PEl9q7YrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="3ae5b4eabc497154ec06437763725203"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="64c68f432be047344448530aa35ba6e8"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="38041dcb73454f1d6f202b449254c59e"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="7830678cf494b0daab9b0558fd64a311">编辑<span class="bjh-image-func-search" data-diagnose-id="a3333edf06547d88122dd161d5b51a2c">搜图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="f1deed82f77df64088d37f2f617f3148">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="b6476227311571fe576ba49ad201709b"><span data-diagnose-id="1817a886f3848ec9ab4cde685c31310a"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="eaadb5f5dc9aa3e1727d2383ed7a6579" data-bjh-helper-id="edda3ee2-8c80-46a8-9ebd-936ad548da9b" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="7952b07f3e0d19777c2d3603c242244b" data-w="1440" data-h="794" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FFTUlqdhn2JQnSKT8VrD9ZSYKq32ifyZaCjA5FFbST27PQfGcLy1dHLYrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FFTUlqdhn2JQnSKT8VrD9ZSYKq32ifyZaCjA5FFbST27PQfGcLy1dHLYrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="f493bed3551b2ca8e93dae4bf2172309"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="289153714f2477a17e0968f2daf040fa"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="d5fdf5a25537a1a0f69c25dceb4e8b76"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="cd8c3c7f919a4609953234b081665219">编辑<span class="bjh-image-func-search" data-diagnose-id="354e480c35505c957ca2b4b3c653f658">搜图</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="227cb5a8296883171917de3552441edb">步骤3：添加条件判断控制器</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="868192b6e1426eaddd0e74e241c44589">1、在新增公寓接口后面添加条件判断控制器</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="64842aa9ab97c0ecfa0e454881ffc247"><span data-diagnose-id="dcba9df3112f46b0189be0bf237a1587"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="9e8f1123bd758316a6497f44fd9740fe" data-bjh-helper-id="0c718180-0e7b-4dad-b97c-4feb76b3b148" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="cd2d1b7632f280e7c95a63942365892c" data-w="1440" data-h="858" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FQpR5%2B6A3S%2FOm0MgJ%2FW8QQ4hk8f3%2BCExcUE9M%2BTMPr3hpQzyNhtXWw7YrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FQpR5%2B6A3S%2FOm0MgJ%2FW8QQ4hk8f3%2BCExcUE9M%2BTMPr3hpQzyNhtXWw7YrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="e9becbfe8c90f3329ee1eaf126cba4fa"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="06bbefe7acda503a9a6c4e9423b57c85"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="8712e7de784035df769b2a1054878e6f"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="fc4a37da9607d69a98136c43b011a786"><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="7e4a5e8653b5266a20797ea8f6d48731">2、设置判断条件</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="aa3b44f488efb289990397999ae26c04">{id} 是一个变量，它来自于前面新增公寓后返回的id 。</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="c1ad61589b4cefcc2cbf65afc7574f67">这个条件判断会检查 {id} 的值。</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="618bc4a43888bd2cb8599291b3da1192"><span data-diagnose-id="eb062fda883b92303130e9291ab6e393"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="2293f3208946ffcbbdd42786f43f8495" data-bjh-helper-id="9316a4d2-6626-4de3-a6d8-07868b5445db" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="c500266b6afcfb3c1309d8bedd6aeaee" data-w="1080" data-h="856" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2F8dttYe2eQKp%2FSuKRYiWQJ%2F4X5BLoInZdYuPtlzRFwDnXMlo5B45ZRrYrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2F8dttYe2eQKp%2FSuKRYiWQJ%2F4X5BLoInZdYuPtlzRFwDnXMlo5B45ZRrYrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="baaea61ebc450aa6ca8091028ed64dd2"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="8352387b9429a8491bb8419d64f58ee2"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="94617c8fe137b2e063ed366538f98d20"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="f495c5d7d0b161f06831d7c5f27085df"><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="137d5eb979a5386d589444d0ba5b2097">&nbsp;</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="c45802f260ad2463f9771c240932d166">3、在控制器添加子步骤：将查询、编辑、删除公寓接口添加到控制器里面</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="2460b8926ed33a85e5c206ccb23124bb">解释：</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="94c5d71abee0872b80ad044f4180f2c9"><span data-diagnose-id="05e1a6cb80294112237eec26ad67723b"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="e354e4a72988fb025e430271e7c6fb49" data-bjh-helper-id="9c8b27ff-d2b1-44ac-a42d-0fb5195c5397" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="00d8b51babd2f93ca393bae7a20f61c0" data-w="1080" data-h="834" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Fygo7EvK5DPKx%2B38Lnl4VqvAItkeIqxBt2mk21UTsbgLLEDBjJetO%2BbYrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Fygo7EvK5DPKx%2B38Lnl4VqvAItkeIqxBt2mk21UTsbgLLEDBjJetO%2BbYrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="856d8225855c1fec844d8a9efe3e8f4e"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="ec93932abc1bf608ff0fcff131c78251"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="105af856a30d865dbe6846c41cd63e58"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="86cded6855f554bae819362753a754ff"><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="e82c130e621baf2b900408fbb2c78292">4、{id} 不为空的执行情况展示</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="454fb2eb96fe023e3eee5628f1e57b41"><span data-diagnose-id="616fa45570e0449f13b274ac78dc55b9"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="81872becdf24603c828276f53ee19ac0" data-bjh-helper-id="a487088e-7118-4226-b4f5-791ed14e80fd" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="60097c594c8c7482143aa7f8f95906b7" data-w="1080" data-h="826" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FFJVuBDt8kzVvynUwrwIYUjpEureQInE2EcAVxEPJCSyyan0F5Fk%2FZrYrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2FFJVuBDt8kzVvynUwrwIYUjpEureQInE2EcAVxEPJCSyyan0F5Fk%2FZrYrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="d1345085082ac15e5ee22d2fba4a1db6"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="37b80e7e524c2e53e2276b785351a4c4"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="a20bb8591fc2412ea190f7c4d41d41d7"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="4f42b277c4f3ac9ebb67d6e5f507b52c"><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="f2198010b3cd66d60715d579acea6d08">5、{id} 为空的执行情况展示</p>
<p data-diagnose-id="cf758a3453d1e28fb39c81d6a463d562"><span data-diagnose-id="bbf365645df8ad6f212846dee4414416"><span class="bjh-image-container cant-justify" data-diagnose-id="063581cd8226ef7feec6867546f1557a" data-bjh-helper-id="ccec880d-fcdf-4d5b-ba95-1cc340eeb526" data-bjh-caption-text="" data-bjh-caption-length="0"><img data-from-paste="1" data-diagnose-id="10e599fb7c6e7ca2f8605d4603f1dbfa" data-w="1080" data-h="797" data-bjh-origin-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Fa6%2B7ynkubvQJ5NtVAG%2BlwLJDkLRnDd7y2jOD%2BOKEiaynVbK%2FgonAFbYrMJ1KUnek" data-src="http://baijiahao.baidu.com/bjh/picproxy?param=usauzJ08pXXKNFzQRZQ7CiZ7%2BSUP0MgE2c1HMWAQZFC5bh0%2FeCj7EIScHUBMc7%2BmmPqLi%2B3p99N9k0ulmU5p0c5Y5Mv%2Fay0%2Fa6%2B7ynkubvQJ5NtVAG%2BlwLJDkLRnDd7y2jOD%2BOKEiaynVbK%2FgonAFbYrMJ1KUnek" class="lazyload"><span class="bjh-image-helper bjh-clear-at-out-put" data-diagnose-id="8b358b4ab11d376b225d524e423b7e87"><span class="bjh-image-func-delete" title="删除图片" data-diagnose-id="9c0e9644889eeafc11d4d337797ea2b1"><span class="bjh-image-func-wrapper" data-diagnose-id="ba7d0868bf13003334f4840dcfa80a34"><span class="bjh-image-func-crop" data-diagnose-id="acfb17f21b7f37aaa1e0fe04e60feec1"><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="template_1 color_000000" data-bjh-box="template_header" data-bjh-params="{&quot;templateId&quot;:&quot;1&quot;,&quot;color&quot;:&quot;000000&quot;,&quot;index&quot;:&quot;03&quot;,&quot;content&quot;:&quot;总结&quot;}" data-diagnose-id="94a766961c6eafbc5e9801e14ad228cb"><strong><span class="count" data-diagnose-id="3f9e56a0771c5154e933a09e0f7fc24b"><span class="content" data-diagnose-id="5390aca8ecb944083280f4ca2942f138">三、总结</span></span></strong></p>
<p data-diagnose-id="ca13c39a6efd0a91d3b67890d02620eb">‍以上就是IF控制器在自动化测试中的完整使用案例；将条件判断与环境变量、数据提取等功能结合，你就能在Apipost中设计出非常强大和智能的自动化测试套件，能够极大地提升API测试的质量和效率。</p>
</div>
